name: Sci-fi
tone: Gritty space frontier in the spirit of Starforged: perilous vows, worn ships, thin margins, found family and hard choices.

roles.name: Soldier
roles.summary: A combat veteran who knows how to take and hold ground.

abilities.name: Stim Rush
abilities.description: Bonus action: regain 1d10 + your level in HP.

abilities.name: Suppressing Fire
abilities.description: Pin a group: until your next turn, they have disadvantage on attacks and can't advance without an Iron save.

roles.name: Pilot
roles.summary: A hotshot flyer who can thread a ship through anything.

abilities.name: Ace
abilities.description: Advantage on Edge checks to pilot, chase or evade in any vehicle you know.

abilities.name: Hard Burn
abilities.description: Once per day, automatically succeed on one piloting check, at the cost of strain on the ship.

roles.name: Engineer
roles.summary: A fixer who keeps failing machines alive with tape and genius.

abilities.name: Gadgeteer (Wits)
abilities.description: Spend a tech charge to deploy a gadget: Repair Drone (restore 1d8 + Wits to a machine or ally's armour-integrated systems), Flashbang (Grit save or blinded for a round), Override (open a lock or seize a system for one minute). Save DC = 8 + Wits mod + proficiency.

abilities.name: Jury-Rig
abilities.description: Patch any broken device for one scene with a Wits check; on a failure it works once and then fails badly.

roles.name: Medic
roles.summary: A field doctor who patches crew up under fire.

abilities.name: Field Surgery
abilities.description: Action: heal an adjacent ally 1d8 + Wits modifier HP.

abilities.name: Combat Stims (Wits)
abilities.description: Spend a tech charge: an ally gains 1d8 + Wits temporary HP and advantage on their next roll, or you neutralise a poison.

roles.name: Scout
roles.summary: A recon specialist who goes first and sees everything.

abilities.name: Ghost
abilities.description: Advantage on Stealth when you move no more than half speed.

abilities.name: Mark Target
abilities.description: Bonus action: for one scene, your attacks against the marked target deal an extra 1d6 damage.

roles.name: Envoy
roles.summary: A negotiator who opens doors that guns cannot.

abilities.name: Silver Tongue
abilities.description: Reroll a failed Heart check and take the second result.

abilities.name: Contacts
abilities.description: In any settled port you can find someone who owes you, knows you, or wants something from you.

openingHooks: Your freighter answers a distress call from a mining station that went silent three weeks ago, and the docking clamps engage on their own.
A corporate fixer offers triple pay to smuggle a sealed cryo-pod past a navy blockade, no questions asked.
The colony's terraforming engine has started broadcasting a message in a language no one recognises.

starts.title: Bleakhold Station
starts.description: A mining outpost bolted to a tumbling asteroid at the edge of the Forge, where the last supply ship is three weeks overdue and the scrubbers are failing.
hooks: Volunteer for the run to the derelict freighter nearby
Find out who sabotaged the oxygen scrubbers

starts.title: The Derelict Kestrel
starts.description: Aboard a colony ship found drifting with its lights on and its cryo-pods empty, your small crew the first to answer its automated distress call.
hooks: Restore power to the bridge
Follow the scratching sound in the cargo deck

starts.title: Rain City, Vanta Prime
starts.description: A neon-drenched orbital port under perpetual storm, where a fixer in a noodle bar offers credits for a data spike nobody else will touch.
hooks: Take the spike and run
Ask who wanted it delivered before you did

starts.title: The Iron Vow
starts.description: Kneeling at a fallen comrade's memorial on a frontier settlement, having just sworn to find the raiders who burned it.
hooks: Track the raiders' ion trail into the asteroid belt
Question the survivor who saw the raiders' faces

starts.title: Crash Site Theta
starts.description: Your shuttle has crash-landed on an uncharted jungle moon; the beacon is dead, the pilot is injured, and something large is moving in the canopy.
hooks: Scavenge parts to repair the beacon
Carry the pilot toward the strange light on the ridge

starts.title: The Precursor Vault
starts.description: An alien vault exposed by a quake on a dusty world, its doors humming with glyphs that rearrange when you look away.
hooks: Touch the glyphs
Hold the vault against the rival salvage crew arriving in orbit

starts.title: Customs Hold at Gate Nine
starts.description: Detained at a jumpgate checkpoint, your ship impounded and cargo flagged as contraband you've never seen before.
hooks: Bribe the customs officer
Break out and reclaim your ship

starts.title: The Long Haul
starts.description: Six months into a slow cargo run between colonies when the navigation AI announces, calmly, that it has changed course.
hooks: Ask the AI why
Cut its power before it reaches the new coordinates

starts.title: Starfall Settlement
starts.description: A farming colony on an ice world, where a burning object has fallen from orbit into the north field and the colonists are too frightened to approach.
hooks: Lead the colonists to the crater
Intercept the corporate ship already descending to claim it

starts.title: The Gladiator Pits of Korr
starts.description: Bought as fighters for a pirate lord's arena on a hollowed-out moon, the first bout scheduled for tonight.
hooks: Win the crowd and the lord's ear
Plan an escape with the other fighters

starts.title: Ghostlight Nebula
starts.description: Drifting in a sensor-blinding nebula where ships vanish, chasing a bounty on a smuggler who hid here a month ago.
hooks: Follow the faint transponder ping
Answer the hail from a ship that went missing ten years ago

starts.title: The Quarantine Ring
starts.description: An orbital hab-ring sealed by a mysterious contagion, your crew docked just before lockdown and now trapped inside with the infected.
hooks: Reach the medical bay and the research data
Find the corporate executive who ordered the seal

starts.title: Envoy's Gambit
starts.description: Hired as security for a diplomat brokering peace between two warring settlements, the talks set to begin as the diplomat fails to wake.
hooks: Investigate the diplomat's quarters
Keep the talks from collapsing while you search

starts.title: Wreckers' Moon
starts.description: A salvage yard moon where crews strip dead ships for parts, and the hulk you just bought at auction still has someone alive inside.
hooks: Cut through the sealed bulkhead
Find out who sold you the wreck and why

artStyle: Painterly science-fiction concept illustration in the style of a roleplaying sourcebook. Realistic proportions, worn practical equipment, dramatic rim lighting, visible brushwork, rich but slightly muted colours.
